title: RSNA Knee Report Labels (Gemini)
subtitle: Gemini-labeled knee MRI reports: 12 findings, 4,407 studies, open method
description: Soft labels (0-1 probability per finding) for the 12 findings in the RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection competition, generated from the free-text radiology report of each of the 4,407 training studies (not the images). Each report was scored in a single structured-output call to Gemini using a prompt with explicit per-finding definitions, then checked against the competition's 58 expert-labeled studies: 0.866 macro AUC. Full generation code, the prompt, and a documented failed attempt to improve the four weakest labels are in the linked GitHub repo. See README.md in this dataset for the per-finding AUC breakdown and known limitations (Synovitis in particular is weak because it's often undocumented in report text even when present on imaging).

resources.description: One row per study. StudyInstanceUID plus 12 probability (0-1) columns, one per finding, scored from the study's free-text report by Gemini. Generated by src/02_label_reports.py in the linked GitHub repo.

fields.name: StudyInstanceUID
fields.description: Unique study identifier, matches the StudyInstanceUID column in the competition's train.csv

fields.name: ACL
fields.description: Probability of anterior cruciate ligament tear/rupture (partial or complete)

fields.name: MCL
fields.description: Probability of medial collateral ligament injury/sprain/tear

fields.name: Medial Meniscus
fields.description: Probability of a tear of the medial meniscus (degeneration alone is scored low)

fields.name: Lateral Meniscus
fields.description: Probability of a tear of the lateral meniscus (degeneration alone is scored low)

fields.name: Medial OA
fields.description: Probability of osteoarthritis in the medial tibiofemoral compartment

fields.name: Lateral OA
fields.description: Probability of osteoarthritis in the lateral tibiofemoral compartment

fields.name: PF OA
fields.description: Probability of osteoarthritis in the patellofemoral compartment

fields.name: Effusion
fields.description: Probability of joint effusion / excess fluid in the joint

fields.name: Synovitis
fields.description: Probability of synovial inflammation/thickening. Weakest label (0.730 AUC vs gold-58) -- often undocumented in report text even when present on imaging

fields.name: Baker's
fields.description: Probability of a popliteal/Baker's/synovial cyst behind the knee

fields.name: Contusion
fields.description: Probability of bone contusion / bone bruise / marrow edema from trauma

fields.name: Fracture
fields.description: Probability of any fracture, including stress/insufficiency/avulsion

resources.description: Methodology: generation prompt/model, label quality vs the competition's gold-58 expert labels (per-finding AUC table), and a documented failed prompt-rewrite experiment on the four weakest labels.
